mobileImplementation: The existing atomic fusion transaction commits one positive receipt for each native follow-up and rolls it back on fusion failure, including Koby's magnitude as a separate penalty receipt.
SignedLineExplosionAdjustment derives the net line bonus from three persisted receipts; no unbounded negative resource balance is used.
The same net bonus feeds the existing line-zone explosive consumer and the existing per-enemy A11S snapshot used by Tesoro's native gold strike.
The line explosive practice multiplier is floored at zero to prevent signed stacking from becoming accidental enemy healing.
A fusion confirmation message shows Lucci's +10% or Koby's -10% adjustment.
knownLimitations: The original B2F and B4J are chat-triggered; the mobile implementation applies their LL delta automatically at the confirmed fusion result as with Dragon.
Koby's B4J also executes ck; that additional original side effect is not claimed as implemented.
